fichas.title: Moving Walkways for Shops and Offices
fichas.summary: Moving walkways, also called conveyors or travelators, transport pedestrians horizontally or on a slight gradient and can also carry prams, wheelchairs, shopping trolleys, bicycles, and bulky luggage. Capacity depends on clear width, speed, and occupancy density. The page describes arrangements, construction, dimensions, speeds, gradients, capacities, and two-way walkway layouts.
uses: Carry prams, wheelchairs, shopping trolleys, bicycles, and bulky luggage
Provide one-way, double, scissors, crossover, and converging walkway arrangements
Connect levels and support two-way circulation
